title: Coasting and Momentum
description: Observe train motion after changing the controller from power to neutral.

steps.instruction: Set P1 to request traction and begin moving the train.
Read the speedometer until it shows a speed greater than 1 km/h.
Select N to remove the active traction request; observe speed while the train coasts.

learningObjective: Explain why a train can continue moving after traction is removed.
operatingConditions: Observe a nonzero speed before selecting neutral.
expectedObservations: N requests neither powered traction nor service braking.
Speed can remain above zero because of momentum and then change due to resistances.
debriefQuestions: Does neutral mean the train has stopped?
Why might speed gradually decrease while coasting?
